rights: Public university PDF bearing an author intellectual-property notice. Only original small derived aggregates and textual locators. No original page, table or raw data mirror.
measurement: Apply calibrated masses to input and output, adding input weight to induce continuous motion in the direct sense; reduce weight until the output moves in the opposite sense. Convert via lever radius and gravity. Tables separate this operating envelope from the two unloaded-end measurements. These are incipient-motion torque thresholds, not powered servo time series, and model repeats share the rig.
statistics: For each gear and each of nine output loads with both directions reported, calculate direct minus indirect input torque within each printed trial column pair, then take the median across repeats. Report the lowest and highest load values and count adjacent load increases that widen the median interval. HFUC, HFUS and HDUR have 3, 4 and 1 repetitions respectively. No individual motor saturation event or waveform was available.
